retrieval.title: Break down sherlock() function to multiple helper functions
retrieval.body: The `sherlock()` function in `sherlock.py` is too large. It needs to be broken down into multiple helper functions to improve readability and maintainability.

retrieval.title: fix: handle UnicodeDecodeError on usernames with special characters
retrieval.body: When running sherlock with non-ASCII or UTF-8 usernames, sherlock.py crashes with a UnicodeDecodeError during the request or logging phase.

retrieval.title: Make Minor Improvements to notify formatting and site loading
retrieval.body: Clean up terminal output formatting in notify.py and improve error checking when loading site definitions in sites.py.

retrieval.title: Rename importable module and adjust package initialization
retrieval.body: Update package initialization in __init__.py and main CLI entry in __main__.py to support importing as sherlock_project.

retrieval.title: Add support for custom timeout parameter in HTTP request sessions
retrieval.body: Allow user to specify timeout flag on CLI to override default request timeouts when testing slow endpoints in sherlock.py.

retrieval.title: Handle connection errors and retry logic when querying target websites
retrieval.body: Catch ClientConnectorError and HTTP connection drops during search loop in sherlock.py and record error in result.py.

retrieval.title: Allow output formatting to CSV and JSON formats from query results
retrieval.body: Export search results collected by QueryResult in result.py into CSV/JSON format and notify user upon completion.

retrieval.title: Update site list validation script and summarize validation status
retrieval.body: Validation script in devel/site-list.py fails on redirected targets. Need to update site-list.py and summarize_site_validation.py.

retrieval.title: Colorized terminal output broken on Windows console
retrieval.body: ANSI color codes displayed as raw escape sequences in notify.py output on Windows platforms. Need Colorama fix.

retrieval.title: SitesInformation class should load targets from local or remote JSON schema
retrieval.body: Refactor SitesInformation in sites.py to validate targets data and handle custom data sources.

retrieval.title: QueryResult status enumeration for available, taken, and error responses
retrieval.body: Define QueryStatus enum in result.py to standardize detection states across search targets.

retrieval.title: Tox configuration for running tests under Python 3.10 and 3.11
retrieval.body: Update envlist in tox.ini to include python3.10 and python3.11 with flake8 and coverage checks.

retrieval.title: CLI argument parser flags for --csv, --xlsx, and --nsfw options
retrieval.body: Add argparse arguments in __main__.py to configure output flags and pass parameters to sherlock search engine.

retrieval.title: Fix false positive detection for sites returning 200 OK on missing profile
retrieval.body: Some websites return status 200 with error message on missing accounts. Improve detection logic in sherlock.py using errorType in sites.py.

retrieval.title: Update Cloudflared and Ngrok tunneling scripts for remote port forwarding
retrieval.body: Cloudflared tunnel fails to initialize on modern Debian systems in zphisher.sh. Update binary download URL and execution check.

retrieval.title: Fix login credentials capture and POST redirect in Facebook phishing template
retrieval.body: The credentials captured in .sites/facebook/login.php fail to save usernames with ampersands, and index.php does not redirect cleanly.

retrieval.title: Fix Adobe landing page form submission handling and assets loading
retrieval.body: The Adobe portal template in .sites/adobe/index.php has broken relative asset paths, preventing login.php submission.

retrieval.title: Update curl user-agent headers and package dependency verification
retrieval.body: Improve dependency checking in zphisher.sh for php, curl, and unzip before starting web server.
